morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，词根开头的 b 保留；belasah 是完整词根，不拆成 belas 与其他成分。

senses.zh_definition: 用力或猛烈地殴打、鞭打；对人施以重击。
senses.en_definition: To beat or thrash someone severely; to strike hard or whip.
senses.nuances: 力度明显强于普通的 memukul，可能涉及拳打、脚踢或器物击打，不限于藤条鞭打。词义依据：[DBP：belasah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belasah)。

collocations.en: to thrash someone with a cane

senses.zh_definition: 比喻在比赛或竞争中以明显优势击败对手，使对方惨败。
senses.en_definition: To defeat an opponent decisively or by a large margin.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, mengalahkan lawan dengan teruknya.
senses.nuances: 常见于体育新闻和球迷聊天，相当于大胜、横扫。语气生动强烈；正式分析可用 menewaskan dengan keputusan besar。词义依据：[DBP：belasah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belasah)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan tuan rumah membelasah pasukan pelawat dengan jaringan lima gol tanpa balas dalam perlawanan akhir semalam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主队在昨天的决赛中以五比零大胜客队。
dual_scenarios.en: The home team thrashed the visitors five-nil in yesterday's final.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pasukan kita membelasah lawan 5–0 semalam, puas hati betul lah!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pasukan kita membelasah pihak lawan dengan keputusan 5–0 semalam; saya benar-benar berpuas hati.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们队昨天五比零大胜对手，真过瘾啊！
dual_scenarios.en: Our team thrashed them five-nil yesterday. That was so satisfying!
spoken_features: 口语省略 pihak，直接用 lawan 指对手。
puas hati betul 加强满足和兴奋的语气。
lah 增添球迷聊天的情绪色彩。
membelasah 的完整形式也自然见于体育聊天。

messages.ms_standard: Pasukan kita membelasah pihak lawan dengan keputusan 5–0 semalam; saya benar-benar berpuas hati.
messages.zh: 咱们队昨天五比零大胜对手，真过瘾啊！
messages.en: Our team thrashed them five-nil yesterday. That was so satisfying!

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah tengok sorotan je, tapi gol terakhir tu memang cantik!
messages.ms_standard: Saya hanya menonton sorotan perlawanan, tetapi gol terakhir itu memang cantik.
messages.zh: 我就看了集锦，不过最后那个进球真漂亮！
messages.en: I only watched the highlights, but that last goal was brilliant!

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects two vivid meanings: physically thrashing someone and decisively defeating an opponent. DBP marks the sporting meaning as figurative, showing how the image of a heavy beating also describes a crushing loss. Membelasah is transparently formed from belasah with meN-; this explanation does not establish a more remote historical origin. [DBP: belasah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belasah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belasah 连成一个动作画面：狠狠地打；换到球场上，就是把对手打得惨败。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是力度强、画面感重的词。用于描述实际殴打时带有明显暴力意味；用于体育比赛则常表达球迷的兴奋。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Aku nak belasah kau 容易被理解为人身威胁，不能当作普遍适用的玩笑。面对输球队的支持者时，使用 membelasah 也可能显得挑衅。
